description: Sends the traveler's name, email and question to the Magenta reservations team, who reply by email. For whole-island stays, weddings, groups, special requests or anything else. Requires the traveler's agreement to share these details (traveler_agreed). Never include payment card numbers.

message.description: What the traveler wants the team to know, in their words.

traveler_agreed.description: true only if the traveler agreed to share these details with Magenta.
